create_habitat_gym_environment: create a Habitat 2.0 Gym environment by importing gym and habitat.utils.gym_definitions then calling gym.make
run_habitat_render_loop: run a Habitat RenderPick environment step loop that samples random actions and records video frames
inspect_habitat_observation_space: inspect the observation space of a Habitat Gym environment like HabitatPick-v0 or HabitatReachState-v0
configure_habitat_gym_override: configure a Habitat Gym environment with override_options to change the gripper controller to SuctionGraspAction
record_habitat_video: record a video of a Habitat environment interaction using habitat_sim viz_utils get_fast_video_writer
